subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Sounds and Spelling – Unit 2, Lesson 8: Graded readers
outcomes: I can read words with oo, or, ng and ai in a story.
I can answer questions about "My tooth" and "Where Is My Food?".
I can put story events in order.

tf.s: In "My tooth", the boy has got a tooth in his hand.
tf.why: The story starts with a tooth in his hand.

tf.s: In "My tooth", the tooth is small.
tf.why: The story says: It is a big tooth.

tf.s: The boy puts his tooth on the roof.
tf.why: He puts the tooth on the roof and sings.

tf.s: The boy waits for the moon.
"Where Is My Food?" is a story about a king.
In "Where Is My Food?", the king is sick.
tf.why: Cook is sick, not the king.

tf.s: At the end, the king makes popcorn.

boxes.q: What is in the boy's hand?
boxes.why: He has got a tooth in his hand.
The story says: It is a big tooth.

boxes.q: What does the boy wait for?
Where does the boy put his tooth?
boxes.why: He puts it on the roof.
The king says: I like food!
The story says: Cook is sick!

hunt.q: He puts the tooth on the ___

mcq.q: In "My tooth", what does the boy do on the roof?
o: He puts his tooth there and sings.
mcq.why: Put your tooth on the roof and sing!

mcq.q: Which word has the or sound?
Who is the main person in "Where Is My Food?"?
mcq.why: The story is about the king.

mcq.q: Which word has the oo sound?

mcq.why: The story says: Wait for the sun.

mcq.q: Which comes first in "Where Is My Food?"?
mcq.why: First Cook is sick, then the king cooks.

mcq.q: Which word from the stories ends with ng?
Can the king cook at the end of the story? How do you know?
mcq.why: He makes popcorn, so he can cook.

mcq.q: Why must the king cook the food?
mcq.why: Cook is sick, so the king cooks.

mcq.q: Which is the right order for "My tooth"?
o: tooth in hand, wait for the sun, put it on the roof
put it on the roof, tooth in hand, wait for the sun
wait for the sun, put it on the roof, tooth in hand
put it on the roof, wait for the sun, tooth in hand
mcq.why: He has a tooth, waits for the sun, then puts it on the roof.
